description: Extract the file generation version from the compiled catalogue (Calenet Silver)

option.name: Username
option.help: Username to access the repository (e. g. GIT use ssh, leave empty)

option.name: Password
option.help: Password to access the repository (e. g. GIT use ssh, leave empty)

option.name: DB Directory
option.help: Subdirectories to store SQL scripts in the database (relative directory relative to project catalogues, leave blank for: db)

option.name: DOC Directory
option.help: Subdirectories to store documents (as opposed to relative directories to project directories, leave blanks for: doc)

option.name: Exclude Directory
option.help: Exclude subdirectories, commas separated, and do not sync these subdirectories

argument.name: Extract List
argument.help: Non-declaration is the automatic extraction of files or directories taken from the project catalogue, e.g., target/*.war or target/*.war:webapp/
